purpose: Old-development-only diagnostics for a conservative P1 risk candidate; not generalization or clinical accuracy

candidate_lock.candidate_policy: Only clear_issue is eligible for automatic risk exclusion; retain review_needed and report its distribution. Never infer clinical correctness.
candidate_lock.validation_policy: Root evaluates separately on the new frozen validation; do not tune this candidate after those outputs are read.

known_development_false_alarm_corrected.change: English month/month-year and faithful Chinese calendar expressions no longer generate quantity/calendar mismatches. Other independent issues may remain.
The initial new candidate failed to recognize an already-present no-longer-visible paraphrase of resolution. Added the observed conservative synonym before freezing; initial diagnostic retained.

known_development_underflag_corrected.change: One device count assertion repeated in a parenthetical alias is treated as one local relation. Separate device clauses still downgrade to review_needed.

review_needed_examples.reason: Selecting one plausible ambiguous date interpretation is review_needed, not a proven incorrect date.
Suspicious finding-to-diagnosis substitutions in multi-finding reports require review.
Device endpoint/detail omission or unmatched central-line terminology remains review_needed.

review_needed_examples.cases: old pilot 3 and 10 in both arms
review_needed_examples.reason: Possible normality-scope expansion and missing resolution meaning remain review_needed.

remaining_false_positive_risk: No independent human review was done. Matched development examples and synthetic tests cannot establish high precision; missing synonym/context can still create flags.
limitations: No supported issue found does not establish source faithfulness, clinical correctness or completeness.
review_needed is a retained review queue, not an automatic rejection or confirmed error label.
Rules were developed on old 18 training-target audits and 10 old pilot-development reports; these are development evidence only.
New human reviews remain zero; neither prior project-AI notes nor rule outputs are human gold.
Date formats and terminology lexicons are finite; ambiguity and source errors are not resolved by this screen.
Clear substitutions require unique local correspondence; multi-finding reports are deliberately downgraded to review_needed.
Explicit quantity changes cover mm/cm and day/week/month/year; organ/value binding and implicit measurements remain unchecked.
Normality, resolution and missing device endpoints are narrow lexical checks; plausible synonyms and cross-sentence references can be missed.
Absence of a target word is not generally proof of omission; most such signals require review.
